comment: What every CI parity step must print, per step and per commit of the checkout its dumps come from (gap 11 (a) of
docs/reassessment/CORRECTNESS.md). Read by tools/ci/check_unittest.py: the step fails unless its unittest run is OK
with exactly 'ran' tests and exactly the listed skips (test id equal, reason matching the regex in full).
Keys of 'expect' are full commits: ec7630a640789c393694fb194f1bbbf0369fc62d is the llama.cpp pin of AGENTS.md
5194a9e1451b885e24dd5a065f650864e8807c59 the ik_llama.cpp R1 pin of tools/engines/pins.json
(.github/workflows/parity-r1-pin.yml). A commit without an entry fails the step: after a pin change, run the step
once, review the counts and add them here with their source. tests/test_check_unittest.py checks that every parity
step goes through the checker and that an entry exists for the commit the step runs at.
'modules' are the unittest modules the step runs (checked against the driver's python3 -m unittest line).
